soldier: Soldiers of three forms. Large form: head brownish yellow, nasus reddish brown, antennae yellowish brown, thorax, abdomen and legs pale greyish yellow; head nearly bare, the tip of the nasus with a few short hairs. Head flattened-round, the sides strongly bulging behind the mid-point, the posterior margin flattened-round. Nasus a stout cone about three-fifths as long as the head, upturned in profile with the tip slightly higher than the top of the head, the base of the nasus deeply concave, the angle between nasus and head about 120°; mandibles with a short apical spine. Antennae 13 segments, the second the shortest, about half the third, the fourth slightly shorter than the third. The anterior raised part of the pronotum strongly sclerotised and with a median incision. Medium form: colour slightly paler, head flattened-round and wider than long, nasus shorter than the head, directed forwards in profile with the tip lower than the top of the head, the base of the nasus seemingly arched; antennae 13 segments, the fourth slightly longer than the second; incision of the anterior margin of the pronotum very shallow. Small form: head elongate-oval, longer than wide, nasus extending straight forwards with the tip slightly lower than the top of the head, the base of the nasus flat; antennae 12 segments, the third 1.5 times the second; anterior and posterior margins of the pronotum nearly straight.
